title: Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan Fee Tariff
content:
**Tariff of transfer fees — Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan.** The figures below are the fees and fee limits each plan tier carries. A fee is owed per early wage transfer and depends on the delivery speed and the destination.

| Tier | Instant to an external debit card (base fee) | Instant to the worker's own Paystride Visa Payroll Card | Next business day to an external bank account (ACH) | Next business day to the worker's own Paystride Visa Payroll Card | Instant transfers per pay period carrying no fee | Fee ceiling per pay period |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Access Starter | 3.49 USD | 0.00 USD | 1.99 USD | 0.00 USD | 0 | 14.99 USD |
| Paystride Access Standard | 3.29 USD | 0.00 USD | 1.99 USD | 0.00 USD | 0 | 12.99 USD |
| Paystride Access Plus | 2.99 USD | 0.00 USD | 1.49 USD | 0.00 USD | 0 | 11.99 USD |
| Paystride Access Preferred | 2.79 USD | 0.00 USD | 1.49 USD | 0.00 USD | 1 | 9.99 USD |
| Paystride Access Premier | 2.49 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.99 USD | 0.00 USD | 1 | 8.99 USD |
| Paystride Access Premier Plus | 1.99 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 2 | 6.99 USD |

## Instant external debit card surcharge by transfer amount

The surcharge is added to the instant external debit card fee by the transfer amount; bands are inclusive at both ends.

| Tier | 5.00 to 100.00 USD | 100.01 to 250.00 USD | 250.01 to 500.00 USD |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Access Starter | 0.00 USD | 1.00 USD | 2.00 USD |
| Paystride Access Standard | 0.00 USD | 1.00 USD | 2.00 USD |
| Paystride Access Plus | 0.00 USD | 1.00 USD | 2.00 USD |
| Paystride Access Preferred | 0.00 USD | 1.00 USD | 2.00 USD |
| Paystride Access Premier | 0.00 USD | 0.75 USD | 1.50 USD |
| Paystride Access Premier Plus | 0.00 USD | 0.50 USD | 1.00 USD |

## Terms of the tariff

- **Instant transfers carrying no fee** — instant transfers per pay period, to any destination, that carry no fee as a tier benefit (count).
- **Fee ceiling per pay period** — the ceiling on transfer fees booked against one pay period, net of fee reversals (USD).
- Transfers to the worker's own Paystride Visa Payroll Card carry 0.00 USD at either speed on every tier.

**Hypothetical band reading.** On Paystride Access Premier, an instant transfer of 180.00 USD to an external debit card falls in the 100.01 to 250.00 USD band, whose surcharge is 0.75 USD, on top of that tier's 2.49 USD base fee; one of 100.00 USD exactly falls in the lowest band and carries no surcharge.
